capabilities: render Tekken notation from code blocks
label notations with a name via name: prefix
append info such as damage via trailing text
extras: Full input list is kept in a Wiki rather than the README; creator accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render Tekken command notation as readable diagrams inside notes.
summary: Code-block renderer that draws Tekken combo notation diagrams from fenced code blocks using the tekken language.
